name: placecall
description: PlaceCall makes AI phone calls that book, confirm, and reach any business. One REST API places a real outbound call and returns a structured outcome plus a full transcript. Free API key at https://api.voygr.tech/checkout

interface.longDescription: PlaceCall places real outbound phone calls to US businesses for your agent: book or cancel a table or an appointment, ask a question, check stock, get a quote. It works through phone menus and hold, then returns a verified outcome and the full transcript. With no number at hand, it can find places worth calling first. The skill sends HTTPS requests to the PlaceCall API at api.voygr.tech with your own API key (free at https://api.voygr.tech/checkout). US numbers only. Every call opens by identifying PlaceCall and stating that the line is recorded.
defaultPrompt: Call this restaurant and ask what time the kitchen closes tonight.
Find a florist in Chicago with fresh peonies today and call them.
Book a table for two tomorrow at 7pm under the name Alex.
